en: Black‑and‑white image of a small harbor packed with wooden fishing boats and sailboats moored at wooden piers. Behind them are rows of traditional wooden boathouses and homes built against rocky hills. The scene shows a coastal fishing village with calm water in the foreground and rugged rock formations in the background. A small logo and number are printed at the lower right, and the location name is printed at the lower left.
